slides.text: I didn't mean to rob the bank. I just walked in wearing a ski mask because it was freezing outside, and I shoved a handwritten note at the teller. The note was supposed to say, 'Can I get fifty dollars in quarters for laundry?' But I had accidentally grabbed my wife's highly aggressive grocery list. It read: 'Give me the cheese or I will end you.'

The teller went completely pale. She didn't even question the bizarre cheese demand. She just started aggressively throwing thick stacks of hundred-dollar bills into my reusable Trader Joe's tote bag. I tried to correct her. 'No, wait, I just need quarters,' I stammered. She thought it was a code word. 'I don't have quarters, please don't shoot!' she sobbed, tossing a stapler into the bag for good measure.

I panicked and ran out of the bank with eighty thousand dollars and a stapler. When I got home, my wife was waiting in the kitchen. I dumped the massive pile of stolen cash onto the table, trembling violently. She stared at the money, then looked up at me with terrifying, icy disappointment. 'You forgot the sharp cheddar, didn't you, Greg?' she sighed, loading a crossbow.
